decisions.evidence: Both original findings accurately describe a nonfatal inconsistency: the page requires listed qsm-states-ensembles in addition to qsm-quasilocal-states, while the batch manifest listed only the latter. The current qsm-quasilocal-states page itself requires qsm-states-ensembles. Removed only the redundant direct edge from the owned page; its mathematical prerequisite reachability, item order and claims are unchanged, and source now matches the assigned manifest. Separate supplier readiness escalations remain open. See research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-alpha-batch-39-3a.md.

The original summary is false for the allowed parameter J=0: the example defines Phi(E_n)=J sigma^z tensor sigma^z and every other term zero, hence all terms then vanish. For J!=0 its two-site unitary has norm one, so an edge term has norm |J|>0. Qualified the owned summary to say nonzero when J!=0, preserving all real J and the verified kappa=2|J|. This confirms the refuter fatal classification of the literal summary claim; the reader called the same issue nonfatal, which does not make its counterexample wrong. See research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-alpha-batch-39-3a.md.
